section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the KIDSCREEN-27 instrument used to assess the psychological well-being dimension of study participants. The KIDSCREEN-27 is a European cross-cultural standardized instrument available in 38 languages, composed of 7 items on a 5-point scale, and has demonstrated good internal reliability for children and adolescents aged 8-18 years. No specific study sample characteristics, country location, or correlation data are provided in this section.
